sourceReview.reason: Broker/branch execution is not beneficial-owner identity. Official product semantics combine securities-firm trading and brokerage-client trading at the broker level; natural-person identity is not established.

sourceReview.source: TWSE Data E-Shop / 外資個股買賣超統計檔
sourceReview.reason: Stock-level directional fields exist, but the investor class is foreign/PRC registered investors, not domestic natural persons.

Historical order data exist, but the public product landing page does not establish a replayable domestic-natural-person identity field. Recent one-year data are not supplied through this historical product, and custom production is required.

Historical execution data exist, but the public product landing page does not establish a domestic-natural-person category field. It therefore cannot be admitted as direct retail flow without the exact field contract.
Natural-person market share is aggregate market structure, not stock-by-date buy/sell direction.

sourceReview.source: TPEx transaction-information store / post-close product groups
sourceReview.reason: Published product groups expose market/statistics/broker/credit-related data families, but this review did not verify a product with domestic-natural-person × symbol × date × buy/sell fields.
Individual investors can request their own records; this is not a marketwide replayable stock-date retail-flow dataset.
